ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Diantz Download and Compress Into a CAB File
ruleDefinitions.description: Download and compress a remote file and store it in a cab file on local machine.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*diantz\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\\\\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cab.*"))
